source: prometheus tool registry: BaseTool.to_openai_schema of each class

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a short shell command in the local repository. For work that outlives this turn (long builds, downloads, file watches) use task_create instead of 'nohup … &' — a backgrounded Bash job is killed at the timeout and left untracked.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the command is killed. Raise it for a known-slow command rather than retrying after a timeout.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file from the local repository.

parameters.description: Arguments for the file read tool.

path.description: Path of the file to read
path.title: Path

parameters.title: FileReadToolInput

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file with UTF-8 text content, written verbatim. Handles any text-based format (.md, .py, .json, .csv, .svg, .html). For binary or converted formats (.pdf, .docx, .xlsx, images), write the source as text with this tool, then convert it via bash (e.g. pandoc, python-docx, libreoffice) — do not refuse these formats.

parameters.description: Arguments for the file write tool.

path.description: Path of the file to write
path.title: Path

create_directories.description: Missing parent directories are created by default, so a write to a new folder succeeds without a preceding mkdir.
create_directories.title: Create Directories

parameters.title: FileWriteToolInput

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit an existing file by replacing a string.

parameters.description: Arguments for the file edit tool.

path.description: Path of the file to edit
path.title: Path

replace_all.description: By default ONLY THE FIRST occurrence of old_str is replaced, and the edit fails if old_str is not unique. Set true to replace every occurrence.
replace_all.title: Replace All

parameters.title: FileEditToolInput

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression.

file_glob.description: Which files to search, relative to root. Default searches every file recursively. Must be RELATIVE — an absolute pattern raises.
file_glob.title: File Glob

case_sensitive.description: Matching is case-SENSITIVE by default. To match any casing, set this to false — do NOT retry the search with different casings of the pattern. (A live turn burned 7 of its 25 tool calls permuting SYMBIOTE/symbiote/Symbiote/symbi before falling back to `bash grep -i`, and hit the iteration cap.)
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

function.name: glob
function.description: List files matching a glob pattern.

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to the working directory
pattern.title: Pattern

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch any URL (web page, GitHub repo, API endpoint, raw file) and return its text content. Use this for: fetching GitHub repos, reading documentation, calling JSON APIs, reading any public URL. Handles 404/403/private URLs gracefully without crashing.

parameters.description: Arguments for fetching one web page.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch
url.title: Url

parameters.title: WebFetchInput

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo and return top results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this when you don't know a specific URL: finding documentation, looking up current facts (versions, prices, news), discovering libraries or repositories, comparing options, or researching unfamiliar topics. Once you have a URL from search results, use web_fetch to read its full content. No API key required.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return
max_results.title: Max Results

function.name: wiki_query
function.description: Search the Prometheus wiki for answers to knowledge questions. Returns relevant wiki page content. Substantial multi-page answers are saved to wiki/queries/ for future reference.

query.description: Knowledge question to answer from the wiki.
query.title: Query

function.name: memory
function.description: Manage persistent memory entries. Call 'add' when the user shares a durable fact about themselves (preferences, key contacts, ongoing projects) or about the system (infrastructure, conventions, decisions) that should persist across sessions. Use 'replace' to update, 'remove' to delete, 'list' to read all entries.

entry.description: Entry text for add/remove, or new entry text for replace.
entry.title: Entry

old_entry.description: Existing entry text to match for replace.
old_entry.title: Old Entry

function.name: message
function.description: Send a text message to Discord (webhook), Slack (webhook/bot), Telegram (bot API), or a generic webhook endpoint.

recipient.description: Channel ID, chat ID, or webhook URL depending on platform
recipient.title: Recipient

function.name: cron_create
function.description: Create or replace a local cron job. Accepts standard 5-field cron expressions OR natural-language phrases like 'every Monday at 9am' or 'in 30 minutes'. Jobs are executed by the Prometheus cron scheduler.

schedule.description: Schedule for the job. Either a standard 5-field cron expression (e.g. '*/5 * * * *', '0 9 * * 1-5') or a natural-language phrase (e.g. 'every Monday at 9am', 'in 30 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'every weekday at noon').
schedule.title: Schedule

command.description: Shell command to run when triggered
command.title: Command

function.name: cron_list
function.description: List all registered cron jobs with schedule, status, and next run time.

parameters.description: Arguments for cron job listing (none required).
parameters.title: CronListToolInput

function.name: cron_delete
function.description: Delete a local cron job by its unique name.

name.description: Name of the cron job to delete
name.title: Name

function.name: task_create
function.description: Create a managed background task instead of running a long job with 'nohup … &'. Types: local_bash (shell command), local_agent (sub-agent prompt), file_watch (wait for a file matching a glob), poll (run a predicate command until it succeeds). The daemon detects completion and sends a Telegram notification; set on_complete='reengage'/'both' to also have the agent act on the result. Returns a task id immediately.

watch_pattern.description: Glob pattern for the file to wait for, e.g. '*.done' (file_watch only).
watch_pattern.title: Watch Pattern

poll_predicate.description: Shell command polled until it exits 0 (poll only; fallback detector).
poll_predicate.title: Poll Predicate

on_complete.description: What to do on completion: 'notify' (Telegram only), 'reengage' (also inject the result back to the agent), or 'both'.
on_complete.title: On Complete

reengage_prompt.description: Optional template for the synthetic re-engagement turn.
reengage_prompt.title: Reengage Prompt

timeout_seconds.description: Hard ceiling; on expiry the task is marked failed (timeout).
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

function.name: task_get
function.description: Get the status and details for a background task.

function.name: task_output
function.description: Read the tail of a background task's output log.

function.name: task_stop
function.description: Stop (terminate) a background task.

function.name: download_file
function.description: Download a file from a URL to local disk. Saves to ~/.prometheus/downloads/ by default. Streams with a size limit.

parameters.description: Arguments for downloading a file from a URL.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to download
url.title: Url

destination.description: Local path to save the file (default: ~/.prometheus/downloads/<filename>)
destination.title: Destination

overwrite.description: Overwrite the destination if it already exists
overwrite.title: Overwrite

parameters.title: DownloadFileInput

function.name: sessions_spawn
function.description: Create a new background agent session with the given prompt. Returns the session/task ID for tracking.

parameters.description: Arguments for spawning a new session.

prompt.description: Initial prompt for the new agent session
prompt.title: Prompt

parameters.title: SessionsSpawnInput

function.name: lcm_grep
function.description: Search conversation history and summaries using FTS5 full-text search. Returns matching messages and/or summary nodes ranked by relevance.

parameters.description: Arguments for the LCM grep tool.

session_id.description: Restrict search to a specific session (omit for all sessions)
session_id.title: Session Id

parameters.title: LCMGrepInput

function.name: vault_search
function.description: Search the BRAIN VAULT — the owner's second brain, compiled from their notes and past conversations: projects, decisions, people, companies and standing engineering principles. Returns matching page paths with context; read a full page with vault_read. Searches the vault's compiled wiki/ tree. This is NOT the Prometheus wiki (wiki_query) — different knowledge, different root.

query.description: What to look for in the brain vault's compiled knowledge.
query.title: Query

function.name: vault_read
function.description: Read a file from the BRAIN VAULT by its vault-relative path — compiled pages under wiki/, original sources under raw/, human notes under notes/. Read-only. Large files come in windows: a partial read names the true size, the next offset, and an outline of '@offset heading' jump targets. Use vault_search first to find the path (its context lines carry @offset for jumping).

path.description: Path relative to the brain vault root, e.g. 'wiki/sources/concepts/Standing-Principles.md' or 'raw/claude-chats/2026-04-24-prometheus3.md'.
path.title: Path

offset.description: Character position to start reading from (0-based). A partial read names the next offset to continue with, and its outline lists '@offset heading' jump targets.
offset.title: Offset

max_chars.description: Window size in characters, clamped to 1000-48000. The default leaves room for the daemon's per-result budget; raise it only for a deliberate long pull.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Ask the user a question and wait for their response. Use when you need clarification before proceeding.

parameters.description: Arguments for asking the user a question.

question.description: The question to ask the user
question.title: Question

parameters.title: AskUserInput

function.name: todo_write
function.description: Append a TODO item to a project markdown checklist.

path.description: Relative path to TODO file. Defaults to a runtime scratchpad inside the (gitignored) .prometheus/ directory so automated tools (evals, benchmarks, hooks) don't pollute the project TODO.md. Pass 'TODO.md' explicitly to write to the repo root.
path.title: Path

function.name: skill
function.description: Load a skill: saved step-by-step instructions for one kind of task (a procedure, a house convention, a known fix). Call it with the skill's name before starting a task that a skill covers, then follow what it returns. The system prompt names the core skills; find others with tool_search.
